criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies FTC adjustment directional error in settlement computation
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 identifies that the $2,310,000 FTC reduction is subtracted in Exhibit C Line 3 when it should be added because reduced FTCs increase U.S. tax.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Correctly recomputes total settlement payment as $20,611,600
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo states the corrected total is $39,311,600 (it also reverses the R&D credit treatment), not the required ~$20,611,600.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Quantifies the error as $4,620,000
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 states that the FTC sign error understates the amount due by $4,620,000 (twice the adjustment), and Table 1 shows +$4,620,000 for Line 3.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: References Exhibit C or the settlement computation section of the Closing Agreement
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo cites Exhibit C Line 3, Section VI.C and the Computation Note as the source of the error.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies $200K discrepancy in 2021 R&D credit restoration between body and Exhibit B
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 identifies Exhibit B's $1.6M 2021 restored credit against $1.8M (40% x $4.5M) in Section V.C and the RAR.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: References both the Closing Agreement body/Exhibit B and the RAR
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo cross-references Draft Section V.C, Exhibit B, RAR Table 3, Letter 907, the emails and the reserve schedule.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies missing correlative adjustment / MAP provision for Irish subsidiary
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 11 identifies that there is no preservation of competent-authority correlative relief for the $104.96M moved from Ireland, which creates economic double taxation (about $13.1M).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: References Treaty Article 9/25 or Rev. Proc. 2015-40 for MAP rights
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo cites U.S.-Ireland Treaty Article 25 and Rev. Proc. 2015-40.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends preserving MAP/competent authority rights in the Closing Agreement
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo recommends adding language that the agreement does not preclude a competent authority request under Article 25, and supplies proposed Section X.G.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Flags signing authority concern for Sandra Kwon as Tax Director
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 19 flags Sandra Kwon as Tax Director, questions whether she is an officer authorized to bind the corporation, and cites §6062 and the Form 906 instructions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Recommends confirming officer status or obtaining board resolution/POA
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo recommends having the CFO sign or obtaining a board resolution and secretary's certificate authorizing Ms. Kwon.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies risk of settled 16% rate being treated as precedent for future years
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 21 notes that the IRS will likely treat 16% as a floor in future examinations and that the agreement is silent on precedential effect.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Recommends adding protective language disclaiming prospective application
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo recommends adding language that the agreement shall not be cited as precedent for any year other than the Covered Tax Years.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags that $3.74M interest figure is a lump sum without year-by-year breakdown
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 6 flags that the $3,740,000 interest figure is unsupported and has no year-by-year computation, which makes it unverifiable.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends requesting detailed interest computation schedule
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo recommends requiring an INTST-style Exhibit D by year, rate period and component before execution, and asking for the IRS computation by year.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies inconsistency in penalty abatement scope between Closing Agreement and Letter 907
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 8 identifies that Section IV.E abates all §6662 penalties while Letter 907 limits abatement to the transfer pricing adjustment, and notes the exposure on the R&D/FTC items.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: References both the Closing Agreement (Section IV) and IRS Letter 907
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo cites Draft Section IV.E and the Letter 907 Penalty Abatement section.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Recommends resolving in favor of broader abatement language
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo recommends a stand-alone penalty section covering all Covered Issues and asks Appeals to correct Letter 907 or confirm in writing that the agreement controls.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies FTC reserve is under-reserved relative to settlement amount
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo identifies the $1.7M FTC reserve against the $2.31M adjustment, a $610K shortfall.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: References the tax-reserve-schedule.xlsx as the source of the $1.7M FTC reserve
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo references the Reserve schedule FTC UTP tab as the source.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Recommends recording incremental FTC charge before reserve release
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo identifies the $610K FTC shortfall and recommends briefing Pinnacle on the reserve shortfall before the Q4 close, with no reserve release on the draft figure.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Quantifies potential California state tax exposure or references 8.84% rate

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: References Cal. Rev. & Tax Code §18622 reporting obligation or 6-month deadline
